extracted.name: Easy Peach Cobbler
extracted.description: Great recipe for Easy Peach Cobbler.
ingredient_lines: 4 cups peeled, cored and diced peaches (about 5 peaches) | or other fruit
instruction_lines: Add the sliced peaches/fruit, lemon juice (I use 3/4 of the lemon) and sugar to a saucepan and stir to combine.
Cook on medium heat for just a few minutes, until the sugar is dissolved and helps to bring out juices from the peaches. Remove from heat and set aside.

Preheat oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit. Slice butter into pieces and add to a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place the pan in the oven while it preheats, to allow the butter to melt. Once melted, remove the pan from the oven.
In a large bowl mix together the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Stir in the milk, just until combined. Pour the mixture into the pan, over the melted butter and smooth it into an even layer.
Spoon the peaches and juice (or canned peaches, if using) over the batter. Sprinkle cinnamon generously over the top.
Bake at 350 degrees for about 38-40 minutes. Serve warm, with a scoop of ice cream, if desired.
